title: everyone-ai
one_liner: A self-service internal developer platform that launches isolated Claude Code workspaces on Kubernetes via a web portal.
what_it_is: everyone-ai is an internal AI workspace platform designed for teams. It provides a web-based portal where users can select from pre-configured templates (e.g., Python, Node.js, HR Agent) to launch personal VS Code environments backed by Claude Code. The system runs on a lightweight k3s cluster, managing workspace lifecycle (creation, monitoring, deletion) and exposing them via secure HTTPS endpoints without requiring local machine configuration or credential management.
how_its_built: The platform consists of a Node.js/Express backend serving a vanilla JavaScript SPA frontend. It interacts directly with the Kubernetes API to spawn 'workspace' pods (running code-server + Claude Code) and 'target' pods (for deployed apps). Infrastructure is bootstrapped using a custom CLI tool called 'afterburner', which installs k3s on remote Linux VMs via SSH and generates Helm charts for deployment. Traefik acts as the ingress controller.
how_to_apply: Operators use the `afterburner` CLI to bootstrap a Linux VM into a k3s cluster and generate Helm install commands. Developers connect via VPN, access the team-specific portal URL, select a template from the App Catalog, and click Launch. The system provisions a unique workspace pod and returns a browser-based VS Code link within ~30 seconds.
quickstart:
npx afterburner bootstrap --host <ip> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
npx afterburner install
helm install everyone-ai-portal ./charts/portal -f profiles/k3s.yaml -f config.yaml --namespace myteam --create-namespace
open https://portal.<your-domain>
features: Self-service App Catalog with pre-configured Claude Code templates
Instant provisioning of browser-based VS Code workspaces (<30s)
Automated k3s cluster bootstrapping via SSH using the Afterburner CLI
Team-isolated namespaces with usage tracking and fleet overview
Persistent HTTPS targets for deploying apps from workspaces
Zero-config client experience: no local credentials or laptop setup required
